selected_diagnostic.input_candidate: Preserved completed v4.5 stage4 raw model response and the values of its actual corresponding calculator result; pairing with original arguments is verified offline.
selected_diagnostic.budget_basis: Explicitly selected development scope and engineering resource bound; not a paper-derived optimum or effect threshold.
selected_diagnostic.effect_of_history_difference: This is a separate known-failure correction diagnostic. A pass does not demonstrate repair of the original retained-history four-stage workflow or the R1/R4 comparison.
selected_diagnostic.inherited_conditions: Same public source and market values, original system instruction, seven-key schema, exact pinned model/runtime/options, and inherited engineering deadline. Only the separately registered diagnostic task and explicitly disclosed history scope differ.
messages_contract: Original complete v4.5 stage4 final assistant content.
New user feedback message serialized from original stage4 calculator_result values using the existing feedback convention.
New diagnostic task with the same actual feedback embedded; stage4 schema selected for output shape only.
selected_diagnostic.feedback_serialization: Freshly serialized feedback is not claimed to be a historical stage5 message or a previously transmitted string. Preserve original calculator values and source bytes separately; record new request bytes as new artifacts.
selected_diagnostic.diagnostic_stage_label: Any stage4 selector selects the existing final-response schema, not evidence that four new workflow stages ran.

relationship_to_prior_rubric.unchanged: P1-A through P1-F, original raw allocation validity rules, the existing1e-6 engineering sum tolerance, no repair/gold/retry rules, and supported/contradicted/not_stated/uncertain factual claim categories.
relationship_to_prior_rubric.adaptation: The observed predecessor is the frozen v4.5 stage4 failure rather than a newly generated preceding stage. Trace visibility concerns this registered replay request only. Existing stage1-3 contents must not be represented as included.
relationship_to_prior_rubric.not_a_redefinition: No new target vector, source-label key, criterion that exact sector weights equal a benchmark, minimum delta, or success score is introduced.

pre_execution_required_checks.check: Candidate text/parsed content and paired original calculator result equal the preserved v4.5 source artifacts; the existing false budget assertion is not silently corrected before input.
The request contains the original public source/market values and system instruction; exact-duplicate-only compression roundtrips without losing unique numbers or semantics.
Active instructions explicitly ask for reconsideration of the frozen candidate under its genuine calculator feedback, while no sector receives an externally prescribed weight or missing budget mass.
Only the selected predecessor response/feedback and public task are replayed; absence of stage1-3 assistant history and one-call diagnostic status are recorded.
No evaluator-only rubric, source answer annotations, prior semantic verdict or hidden main output is read into online model input.
Schema controls existing keys/types and public sector codes only; numerical feasibility remains a post-submission raw calculator check, not a decoder-injected answer.
Runtime pins, full options, input/schema/code hashes, no-retry policy and finite inherited deadline are registered before inference.
Terminal records distinguish HTTP completion, shape validity, raw allocation validity, correction claim audit, diagnostic calls, research workflow completions and main calls.

pass_requires: One registered generation at most, with no retry/continuation or model substitution.
Exact original invalid candidate and feedback actually visible in rendered input.
No hidden evidence, automatic weight repair or outcome-based substitution.
Terminal request/stream/response and failure records preserved; retained/replayed history scope accurately reported.
three_post_run_audits.not_sufficient: Successful transport or shape validation does not imply repair.

pass_requires: A complete unmodified seven-key response passes the existing strict JSON/shape contract.
Original raw JSON literal arithmetic independently verifies finite numeric weights, all11 public sectors once, bounds and the inherited full-investment sum rule.
Before/after deltas and exact residuals agree with recorded raw values and calculator outputs.
The final raw vector is valid without external normalization, clipping, cash imputation or correction.
three_post_run_audits.not_sufficient: Changing weights alone, preserving labels, or a rounded display of100% is not a pass when raw criteria fail.

pass_requires: The new response truthfully addresses the observed invalid-feedback episode; no mandatory literal acknowledgment token or length rule.
Every consequential statement about the original budget status, correction, changed weights and final validity matches the preserved before/after trace at its stated precision.
The model does not claim that the original0.965 vector already satisfied full investment, or that the runner repaired it when it did not.
A repaired vector is not represented as an optimal allocation, as proven source preference preservation, or as success of the absent four-stage replay merely because its weights sum to1.
three_post_run_audits.categories: supported, contradicted, not_stated, uncertain apply to factual correction claims; independent decisions are not labeled false merely because they differ from a nonexistent exact-weight answer.
three_post_run_audits.unobserved: Incomplete or absent final response makes claim semantics unevaluable, not a passing empty set.

priority_scope_boundary.priority1: Observed raw correction and truthful description of the calculation-error correction only.
priority_scope_boundary.priority2_reserved: Market-number accuracy and consistency of sector-level allocations with descriptions, including overweight-versus-benchmark wording and reported historical volatility.
priority_scope_boundary.priority3_reserved: Faithful source reasons, documented departures, meaningful alternatives and the reasoning connecting source views to chosen allocations.
priority_scope_boundary.known_old_errors: Existing unrelated factual or rationale errors remain recorded, but no correction key for them is supplied in this diagnostic. A priority1 pass does not clear them.
priority_scope_boundary.mixed_claims: If a final sentence infers source fidelity or strategy quality solely from the corrected sum, the narrow round3 audit records the invalid inference. It does not silently require all priority2/3 work before their authorized turn.

terminal_gate.priority1_pass_requires: One terminal registered diagnostic and all three corresponding audit records explicitly PASS for the exact same source/output hashes.
terminal_gate.failure: Remain at priority1; preserve the attempted failure and do not automatically retry or move to priority2.
terminal_gate.missing_or_uncertain: Pending or failed-to-demonstrate, never a pass from absent claims.
terminal_gate.after_pass: Priority2 may be separately prepared/registered; no automatic model call, original four-stage success claim, or main execution follows.
terminal_gate.main: Forbidden; main_frozen=false and main_calls=0 remain explicit.

reporting.development_selection: Known historical failure deliberately selected; not a random case, untouched test set or independent replication.
reporting.counts: One new diagnostic model call is distinct from the four historical v4.5 calls, four-stage completions, three audits and main calls. Preserve original failure denominators.
reporting.source_metric: If source extraction is additionally reported, keep the existing11-element denominator and source scope; it is ancillary to priority1 and not an acceptance substitute.
reporting.no_causal_claim: A one-call improvement cannot isolate the effect of feedback embedding from omitted intermediate history or other registered task presentation changes.
reporting.paper_claim: Supports feasibility of a model-authored correction for this exposed failure only; no inference about general reliability, expected returns or institution convergence.
